description.en: Creates a map-attached visual effect (e.g. an ambient/weather overlay) by name, returning its handle. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Name of the map effect to create.
Handle of the created map effect.

example.code:
// Create an ambient map effect by name
local hMapEffect = CMND_CREATE_MAP_EFFECT("fog01");
